Desc.LocalizedString: A resplendent edition chest released by the Challenge Committee. Symbolizing the pinnacle of glory, it belongs to the players who reach the top of the world.

Desc.SourceString: 回味时光咖啡厅热销的新款蛋糕，黑白巧克力构成的琴键，奏响的是甜蜜的乐章。
Desc.LocalizedString: The best-selling new cake from Café Reminiscence. The piano keys made of black and white chocolates play a sweet melody.

Desc.SourceString: 新世界的游戏技术标杆，虚拟体感技术的科技结晶，虽然是游戏，但也不是闹着玩的。
Desc.LocalizedString: A technological benchmark of gaming in the new world. The fruit of virtual somatosensory technology. Although it's used for gaming, it must be treated seriously.

Desc.SourceString: 可以令人和敬清寂的茶道套装，利于使用者以谦敬之心达致“禅”的意境，隔绝外界的喧嚣。
Desc.LocalizedString: A tea ceremony set that enables the wearer to be isolated from the outside world to achieve harmony, respect, purity and tranquility. The ultimate state of Zen.

Desc.SourceString: 无需多言，独属于我的旋律，我早已遇见。
Desc.LocalizedString: No words are needed, for I have already encountered my unique melody.

Desc.SourceString: 出品白芸艺术馆的绘画套组，其中内含大艺术家玛德蕾娜的绘画教程。
Desc.LocalizedString: A painting set produced by Cloudscape Gallery, containing a painting tutorial by the great artist Maddelena.

Desc.SourceString: 高等弦理论知识书籍，打开这本书可以窥见入门，到直接入土。
Desc.LocalizedString: A textbook on advanced string theory that offers everything you need to know on the subject.

Desc.SourceString: 即便触摸星空很难，但让星星伴你入睡非常简单。
Desc.LocalizedString: Although it is difficult to physically touch the starry sky, having the stars accompany you in your sleep is quite simple.

Desc.SourceString: 世界上有很多未解之谜，即便到了这个世界，很多事情依然是悬而未决的秘密。
Desc.LocalizedString: The world is filled with many unsolved mysteries, and even in Strinova, numerous secrets remain hidden.

Desc.SourceString: 放在桌面就会跳起舞的熊玩偶，传闻编舞者是伊薇特。
Desc.LocalizedString: A toy bear that dances when placed on a desk, rumored to have been choreographed by Yvette.

Desc.SourceString: 去往真实荒野的必备道具，集合了勘探、导航、求救信号发送，甚至一键点火功能。
Desc.LocalizedString: An essential item for True Wilderness adventures. Featuring exploration, navigation, distress signal, and even a push-button start.

Desc.SourceString: 这一款专业级麦克风的性能十分强大，不仅能提供动感而细节丰富的声音，而且能有效隔绝周围环境的噪音，让“麦霸们”不受环境的限制，随时开麦唱歌。
Desc.LocalizedString: This professional microphone is incredibly powerful. In addition to providing dynamic and crisp sound, it can also isolate noise from its surroundings, allowing “mic warriors” to sing freely, no matter where they are.

Desc.SourceString: 摁下牙齿就会合上嘴的玩具，适合用来锻炼反应速度，放心，它的牙是软的。
Desc.LocalizedString: A shark toy that closes its mouth when the correct tooth is pressed, suitable for training your reaction speed. Don't worry; its teeth are soft.

Desc.SourceString: 存储量相当大的手账集，在高科技结合下保留了纸质书籍的翻页手感，除了文字外也可以存储照片，并附赠多款贴纸样式。
Desc.LocalizedString: A large planner set that maintains the feel of a paperback with the innovation of technology. Other than text, it also stores photos, and can come with various stickers.

Desc.SourceString: 充满艺术感的桌面摆件，昂首的姿态使人感到无比振奋。
Desc.LocalizedString: An artistic desk ornament with an uplifting posture.

Desc.SourceString: 专注于追逐风暴的防风镜，极限飘飞爱好者的首选！我们承诺送货上门！（基地城、真实荒野等存疑争议地区不包邮）。
Desc.LocalizedString: A pair of windproof goggles for gliding enthusiasts looking to chase storms! Door-to-door delivery guaranteed! (Excluding disputed areas such as Base City and the True Wilderness)

Desc.SourceString: 以某著名漫画联名的笔记本，据说可以把不喜欢的人的名字写上去，但这也只是笔记本而已，不是真货
Desc.LocalizedString: A notebook designed in collaboration with a famous manga. It is rumored that you can write down the names of people you dislike in the notebook, but it is not the real deal.

Desc.SourceString: 画我所思，绘我所想，它能够实现一切绝佳的创意与灵感！由温克勒商会倾力打造，“理想乡”最好的绘画屏！
Desc.LocalizedString: Draw your thoughts and paint your imagination! It helps you achieve all your creative aspirations! Produced by Winkler Consortium, it is the best drawing pad available in "Utopia!"

Desc.SourceString: 冰量加大、噪音降低版的高级制冰机。有了它的话，就能随时随地享受美味的冰饮了吧~
Desc.LocalizedString: An advanced icemaker with increased capacity and reduced noise generation that allows you to enjoy refreshing drinks anytime and anywhere!

Desc.LocalizedString: Combining fillings of salted meat and a crispy crust, this traditional delicacy is uniquely savory.

Desc.SourceString: 占风铎曾被用于测量风向，如今多作为装饰使用。星星占风铎是梦幻般的紫色，只需静静凝望，就能获得心灵的平静。

Desc.SourceString: 占风铎曾被用于测量风向，如今多作为装饰使用。这只占风铎上的小海兔，好像在哪里见过？

Desc.SourceString: 占风铎曾被用于测量风向，如今多作为装饰使用。优雅而美丽的独角兽，让这枚占风铎更显身价不菲。
Desc.LocalizedString: Once used for measuring wind direction, wind chimes are now often used as decorations. The elegant and beautiful unicorn makes these wind chimes even more valuable.

Desc.SourceString: 占风铎曾被用于测量风向，如今多作为装饰使用。山茶花占风铎清隽优雅，似乎散发着幽香。
Desc.LocalizedString: Once used for measuring wind direction, wind chimes are now often used as decorations. The camellia wind chimes reflect purity and elegance, and seem to exude a delicate fragrance.

Desc.SourceString: 占风铎曾被用于测量风向，如今多作为装饰使用。彩虹占风铎在被风吹响之时，也能挥洒出缤纷的色彩吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Once used for measuring wind direction, wind chimes are now often used as decorations. The rainbow wind chimes explode in color when blown by the wind.
